load_pe_model: load a prompt-enhancement causal LM model from a component path using PELoader.load_customized
generate_text: generate text from a PEModelWrapper using a prompt and sampling parameters
read_model_max_length: read model_max_length from tokenizer_config.json in a model directory
move_model_device: move a PEModelWrapper underlying model to a different device using the to method
wrap_pe_model: wrap a transformers causal LM model and tokenizer into a PEModelWrapper instance
